summary: Wrote a six-phase implementation plan for worktree-to-checkout resolution of the Sapience per-project MCP registration. Research finding that Claude Code's own ~/.claude.json lookup already resolves a worktree to its checkout entry removed the anticipated teardown/retraction mechanism from scope entirely, and confirmed setup-sapience-mcp.sh needs no change. The plan adds the write-side slug site (sapience-remember.sh) beyond what research named, since a worktree-tagged write would be invisible to every later query and would defeat acceptance criterion 1 from the other direction. Phase 6 declares __WHOLE_TREE__ because verify-deploy gate 5 compares source-store content hashes against the deployed tree.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan: hook resolution, verifier lockstep plus check (f), three slug sites, four worktree regression cases plus a lockstep guard, domain-note two-channel asymmetry, live acceptance plus full gate set.
